description: The C_ANASEL block is used for displaying analog values, selecting one of 16 analog values, and switching it to the output, typically used in cement plant applications such as mill drive control.

inputs.name: In01
inputs.description: Input signal 1, containing the value and signal status, typically from a measure or controller block.

inputs.name: In01Stat
inputs.description: Input signal 1 unit and status, containing the unit and object status, typically from a measure block.

inputs.name: SelInt
inputs.description: Selection number, determining which input interface is copied to the output.

outputs.name: Out_Val
outputs.description: Output signal, containing the analog value and signal status.

outputs.name: Out_Stat
outputs.description: Output signal unit and status, containing the unit and object status.

outputs.name: CL_HH
outputs.description: Overall limit alarm (HH), containing the accumulative HH limits of all connected inputs.

outputs.name: CL_H
outputs.description: Overall limit warning (H), containing the accumulative H limits of all connected inputs.

outputs.name: CL_L
outputs.description: Overall limit warning (L), containing the accumulative L limits of all connected inputs.

outputs.name: CL_LL
outputs.description: Overall limit alarm (LL), containing the accumulative LL limits of all connected inputs.
